comment: Read from src/ConductorGrid at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Conductor - Grid, which matches the code. The eight pads are configured as buttons named Pad 1 to Pad 8 (ConductorGrid.cpp:36); the two page buttons are added by the widget with no configButton call at all, so they have empty hover text. The module declares no inputs and no outputs, so there are no port props to give.
